description: Full ClinVar MSH3 germline variant spectrum: classification distribution and consequence classes among pathogenic/likely pathogenic alleles
code:
import requests, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
ids=[]; total=None
for retstart in range(0, 8000, 500):
    r=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi", params={"db":"clinvar","term":'MSH3[gene]',
        "retmax":500,"retstart":retstart,"retmode":"json"}, timeout=90).json()["esearchresult"]
    total=int(r["count"]); b=r["idlist"]
    if not b: break
    ids+=b
    if len(ids)>=total: break
    time.sleep(0.34)
print("ClinVar MSH3 records retrieved:", len(ids), "of", total)

rows=[]
for i in range(0, len(ids), 300):
    s=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi", params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+300]),
        "retmode":"json"}, timeout=150).json()["result"]
    for uid in ids[i:i+300]:
        d=s.get(uid)
        if not isinstance(d,dict): continue
        g=d.get("germline_classification",{}) or {}
        vs=(d.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]
        rows.append({"clf":g.get("description","NA"), "type":vs.get("variant_type","NA"),
                     "name":vs.get("variation_name","")})
    time.sleep(0.34)
cv=pd.DataFrame(rows)

def consequence(nm, vtype):
    p = nm.split("(p.")[-1] if "(p." in nm else ""
    if re.search(r"c\.[\d_+-]+[+-]\d", nm) and "del" not in p and "fs" not in p and "Ter" not in p:
        return "splice site"
    if "fs" in p: return "frameshift"
    if "Ter" in p and "delins" not in p: return "nonsense / stop-gain"
    if "delins" in p or "insTer" in p: return "frameshift"
    if re.match(r"^[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+[A-Z][a-z]{2}\)?$", p): return "missense"
    if vtype in ("copy number loss","copy number gain"): return "copy number"
    if re.search(r"[+-]\d+[ACGT]>", nm) or re.search(r"\d[+-]\d", nm): return "splice site"
    return "other / non-coding"

cv["csq"]=[consequence(n,t) for n,t in zip(cv.name, cv.type)]
plp = cv[cv.clf.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])]
print("\nTotal P/LP:", len(plp))
print(plp.csq.value_counts())
print("\nP/LP missense entries:")
print(plp[plp.csq=="missense"].name.tolist()[:20])
print("\nAll classifications:")
clf_counts = cv.clf.replace("", "not provided").value_counts()
print(clf_counts)
vus = clf_counts.get("Uncertain significance",0)
print(f"\nVUS share: {vus}/{len(cv)} = {100*vus/len(cv):.1f}%")

# ---------- figure ----------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14,5.6))
ax=axes[0]
order=["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic","Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity",
       "Uncertain significance","Likely benign","Benign","Benign/Likely benign"]
vals=[clf_counts.get(o,0) for o in order]
cols=["#C44E52","#C44E52","#C44E52","#DD8452","#8C8C8C","#55A868","#55A868","#55A868"]
lab=[o.replace("Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity","Conflicting") for o in order]
ax.barh(range(len(order))[::-1], vals, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(lab, fontsize=9)
for i,v in zip(range(len(order))[::-1], vals):
    ax.text(v+40, i, str(v), va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("ClinVar germline records"); ax.set_xlim(0, max(vals)*1.18)
ax.set_title(f"A. MSH3 germline variants in ClinVar (n={len(cv)}):\n{100*vus/len(cv):.0f}% are variants of uncertain significance", fontsize=10.5)

ax=axes[1]
cq=plp.csq.value_counts()
ax.bar(cq.index, cq.values, color="#4C72B0")
for i,v in enumerate(cq.values): ax.text(i, v+2, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("pathogenic / likely pathogenic records")
ax.set_title(f"B. The {len(plp)} P/LP MSH3 alleles are almost all\ntruncating: no reported pathogenic missense", fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=20, labelsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0, cq.values.max()*1.15)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
